identity.question: Will Zohran Mamdani win the 2025 NYC mayoral election?
identity.rulesSummary: YES if Mamdani wins the November 4, 2025 NYC mayoral general election. AP, Fox News and NBC agreeing determine resolution; otherwise official certification applies. This is not the Democratic primary contract. Cuomo’s primary concession can be scored; the November general-election victory cannot.

audienceRationale: New York, Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez, Andrew Cuomo and a young insurgent challenging the establishment make a recognizable political drama, though less universal than TikTok or the Super Bowl.
playRationale: An endorsement from AOC, a rival refusing to disappear, the governor coming aboard and the sitting mayor leaving sound like big turning points. Players may overrate them compared with the primary breakthrough.
tension: The general-election contract moves +33.80 pp around the primary concession, while the other four frozen responses range only from −1.025 to +1.80. The full series has a 20.90-point pre-result drawdown, but the frozen card set does not capture a comparably substantial fall. This fails the strongest-puzzle ambition despite usable data.

selectionFreeze.disclosure: Freeze these five fact clusters per candidate for historical significance before running fresh event-window calculations. Timestamp anchors must come from public evidence, never optimized on prices. Failed candidates stay failed; do not replace weak cards after seeing movements. Raw histories and broad daily-median suitability statistics were examined before this freeze; no new five-card event-window calculations have run. Prior project records contain measured responses for some reused Trump/Eagles events and Oscars 2026; those were visible while satisfying the required repository review. This is a prospective freeze of this research selection, not a claim of blinded preregistration.
